answer: Correlated-fault penalties: when several agents miss the same audit or fail in lockstep, each one's bond is cut by an amount that grows with the size of the failing group. An honest agent is a lone oasis whose rare errors cost little, but a sybil farm sharing one model and one server cracks together like shale, so its losses peak at the zenith exactly when it matters. Running many fake identities becomes a liability, not an edge.
